method: Built-in image_gen using the approved Border Collie as a graphic-style reference; converted into native SVG paths with vtracer 0.6.15 via scripts/trace-walking-artwork.py.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one standalone POMERANIAN dog in the established DNAture mint-and-ink engraving graphic line. The supplied Border Collie is ONLY a style reference for crisp tapered engraved fur strokes, palette and natural standing presentation; do not copy its breed or proportions. One realistic adult Pomeranian standing naturally on all FOUR legs facing RIGHT, body in side profile and head gently turned three-quarter toward the viewer. Unmistakable Pomeranian traits: small compact short-backed spitz body, foxlike tapered muzzle, small upright pointed triangular ears visible above the fur, alert natural almond eyes, thick abundant double coat, broad fluffy neck ruff and chest mane, fine feathered legs with four distinct small paws, profuse plume tail set high and curling over the back. Keep anatomical limbs plausible under the coat; full natural untrimmed coat, no teddy-bear haircut, no round toy face. Calm attentive friendly expression, closed mouth, no human smile. Match the reference's meticulous tapered engraving lines following fur growth, airy crosshatching and clear volume. Long layered flowing strokes distinguish fluffy coat without becoming solid black masses. Mint-dominant drawing with ONLY exact luminous mint #8FE4D9 and deep cool ink teal #092F39 inside the dog, flat colors, clear face, restrained shadow density. Square canvas with comfortable TRANSPARENT margins around all ears, fur wisps, plume tail and paws. Entire dog uncropped. Genuine alpha transparency directly outside the crisp fur silhouette and between legs, opaque mint inside silhouette. No background, printed checkerboard, floor, ground shadow, halo, glow, colored haze, gradients, blur, photographic texture, cartoon, 3D, text, watermark, border, collar, clothing, props or additional animals. No white, black, orange, brown, sepia or other warm colors. This is a reusable clean cutout animal engraving for the same DNAture breed series.
